_readme: Fixed observations and the exact float32 outputs of the torch actor AS EXPORTED (rsl_rl MLPModel: (x - mean)/(std + 1e-2), then Linear/ELU x3, bare Linear head, deterministic mean; for a policy with rotation_baked = true these are the ROTATED weights, i.e. what <name>.bin holds). The JS runtime must reproduce act to < 1e-5. obs were drawn as mean + std*z from each policy's own normalizer stats with numpy default_rng(seed), seed = int(sha256(name)[:8], 16); rows 0-3 use z ~ N(0,1), rows 4-7 z ~ N(0,3).
